facts.text: The hotel is set in the heart of Shenzhen's Overseas Chinese Town.
facts.excerpt: Experience a fusion of cultures at this chic urban resort hotel set in the heart of Shenzhen’s Overseas Chinese Town.

facts.text: The hotel blends Spanish-inspired elegance with modern design and local traditions.
facts.excerpt: Blending Spanish-inspired elegance with modern design and time-honoured local traditions

facts.text: A 10,000-square-meter Caribbean garden surrounds the hotel's swimming pool.
facts.excerpt: Our immaculately landscaped 10,000 square metre Caribbean garden encircles our expansive swimming pool, creating an oasis of calm.

facts.text: The Caribbean garden has a real sand beach and an outdoor pool anchored by a Spanish boat and palm trees.
facts.excerpt: The 10,000-square-meter Caribbean garden features a real sand beach and a 2,000-square-meter outdoor pool, anchored by iconic Spanish boat and palm trees that presents a sense of urban resort.

facts.text: Children have an outdoor play area, a Spanish galleon, a kids' pool and waterfalls in the garden.
facts.excerpt: Children will be delighted by an outdoor play area, Spanish galleon, kids' pool, waterfalls, and a real sand beach.

facts.text: The hotel has an indoor heated pool alongside a gym, sauna, steam bath, yoga studio and hair and nail salon.
facts.excerpt: The hotel provides an indoor heated swimming pool equipped with a wealth of fitness facilities, including gym, sauna, steam bath, yoga studio, hair and nail salon, etc..

facts.text: Waterfall Spa and Wellness offers hydrotherapy, sauna and steam bathing.

facts.text: Guest rooms begin at 55 square meters.
facts.excerpt: Our guest rooms begin at a spacious 55 square meters

facts.text: Room styles range from Spanish and Chinese motifs to modern and classic designs.
facts.excerpt: offer a curated selection of styles, from the vibrant essence of Spain and the refined elegance of Chinese motifs to sleek modern and timeless classic designs

facts.text: Most rooms have a private balcony with views of the Caribbean-inspired garden.
facts.excerpt: Most rooms feature a private viewing balcony, presenting panoramic views of our Caribbean-inspired garden landscape.

facts.text: Rooms have an LCD television, a Bose sound system and a work area.
facts.excerpt: complete with an LCD television, a Bose sound system, and a stylish, comfortable work area

facts.text: The bathroom integrates a spa-style bathtub with entertainment.
facts.excerpt: The expansive bathroom seamlessly integrates a spa-style bathtub with entertainment

facts.text: Club InterContinental guests get breakfast, afternoon tea, cocktail hour and late-night snacks in the 7th-floor Club Lounge.
facts.excerpt: Guests staying on the InterContinental Club floors receive complimentary access to the InterContinental Club Lounge on the 7th floor. Club InterContinental guests enjoy complimentary breakfast, afternoon tea, cocktail hour, and late-night snacks.

facts.text: Joy Kids Utopia is a family restaurant with a bakery, storybook corner, party rooms and terrace, plus a 4,000-square-meter outdoor kids club.
facts.excerpt: Spanning 580 square meters, it features a beverage bar, bakery, storybook corner, family activity area, party rooms and outdoor terrace. Wholesome ingredients and playful creations make every meal an adventure, while the 4000 square meter outdoor kids club

facts.text: El Chino serves refined Cantonese cuisine in a setting inspired by traditional Lingnan gardens.
facts.excerpt: El Chino Chinese Restaurant celebrates the essence of refined Cantonese cuisine while embracing the spirit of innovation and openness that defines Shenzhen. Inspired by traditional Lingnan gardens

facts.text: Mercado Restaurant & Cafe is inspired by Madrid's plazas and Spanish food markets.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by the iconic plazas of Madrid and vibrant Spanish food markets

facts.text: Lounge 1982 is named for the Shenzhen Bay Hotel, which opened on the same site in 1982, and is shaped like a miniature Spanish bullring.
facts.excerpt: Named in memory of Shenzhen Bay Hotel which opened in 1982 in the same location, this round-shaped architecture is the miniature of the Spanish bull fighting ring.
